info.title: IgnitePost Universal API
info.description: Create, preview, and track handwritten card orders

get.description: Tests your IgnitePost authentication and returns your account email.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

email.description: Email address for the authenticated IgnitePOST account.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates a new order in IgnitePost.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

font.description: IgnitePOST font key from the List Fonts action.

message.description: Handwritten message content, up to 450 characters.

image.description: Front image key from List Default Images or a public image URL.

imageInside.description: A stock image key or image URL for the card interior.

imageBackside.description: A stock image key or image URL for the card back.

insert.description: An optional IgnitePOST insert key, such as a gift card insert.

recipientEmail.description: Recipient email address for delivery notifications.

recipientCompanyName.description: Recipient company name for business deliveries.

recipientAddressTwo.description: Recipient street address line 2, such as a suite or apartment.

senderName.description: Sender name shown on the card.

senderAddressTwo.description: Sender street address line 2, such as a suite or apartment.

sendOn.description: Schedule the order for a future send date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

letterTemplateId.description: Letter template ID from the List Letter Templates action.

uid.description: Your external unique identifier for the order.

metadata.description: Object of key-value metadata to attach to the order.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order was created.

letterTemplateId.description: Template identifier returned on the observed create-order response.

metadata.description: Arbitrary order metadata returned by IgnitePost.

recipientCountry.description: Recipient country code returned on the observed create-order response.

senderCountry.description: Sender country code returned on the observed create-order response.

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the order was sent.

uid.description: External identifier from the calling system.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
